verifiedCapability: Canonical-provenance surface aliases no longer manufacture a false conflicting-triage HOLD during dynamic decomposition. Genuine disagreement in classification or canonical provenance still preserves the parent conflict on HOLD.
provenance: Synthetic de-identified fixtures only. No private Drive name, ID, URL, or source text is stored.
boundary: This verifies bounded structural alias handling under the current canonicalEvidenceProvenance contract. It does not prove that two differently written provenance labels are semantically the same real-world source, nor that the canonicalizer cannot over-collapse genuinely distinct identities.
